name: Visa Live at le Louvre
desc:
Come experience Musée du Louvre like never before! Visa Live at le Louvre is a special advertising concert event brought to you by Visa.

🖼️ Visit the Louvre Museum Experience and learn more about some of the most iconic masterpieces in the world!
🎁 Stop by the Louvre Collectibles to redeem your collected rings for UGC
👗 Hit up the Visa Concert Collectibles to shop for cool concert items and gear!
🎨 Create and Share Your Own Artwork in Artist Square!

Louvre Collectibles UGC items are not sellable or tradeable once redeemed.

To play Visa Live at Le Louvre on Roblox you need to be at least 13 years old.  You can find information about Visa's collection and use of information in relation to this game on entering the game.
